Executive summary for the 90-day window: the portfolio of 12 customers
shows 24 adoption barriers (7 critical, 18 still open) and 31 TAC cases,
of which 3 are P1 and 14 remain open. Total ARR at risk is approximately
$1,250,000 (~40% concentrated in Acme Corp at $500,000), with Beta Inc
($300,000), Gamma Ltd ($250,000), and Delta Co ($200,000) rounding out
the top exposures. The most frequent barrier theme is provisioning
delays affecting 8 customers, followed by authentication / SSO at 5.
Recommendation: focus the next 30 days on the 7 critical barriers and
the 3 P1 cases concentrated on Acme Corp and Beta Inc. External
incidents (6) and bugs (11) cited in this window do not currently align
with any open P1 case, but should be tracked for emerging patterns.
